2. Reason: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the disease is "Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI)" based on a misinterpretation of the search results. SARI is a clinical syndrome used for surveillance, not the specific name of the viral disease Yi Guan is famous for preventing. The search results and the article title ("Bird Flu, SARS and Beyond") explicitly mention SARS (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome). The Planner failed to verify the specific disease name linked to Yi Guan's most prominent work (sequencing the SARS-CoV genome which helped prevent future outbreaks) and prematurely marked the task as complete with an inaccurate answer.
